verses.text: Look, a day is coming for the LORD when the goods taken from you will be divided up right inside your city.

I will gather all the nations to fight against Jerusalem. The city will be captured, the houses looted, and the women attacked. Half the people will be taken away as prisoners, but the rest of the people will not be removed from the city.
Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as he fights on a day of battle.

On that day his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem. The Mount of Olives will split in two from east to west, making a huge valley. Half of the mountain will move north, and half will move south.

You will run away through my mountain valley, because the valley between the mountains will reach as far as Azel. You will run just as you ran from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.
On that day there will be no light, no cold or frost.
It will be a unique day, known only to the LORD — not day and not night. But when evening comes, there will be light.
On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it toward the Dead Sea and half toward the Mediterranean Sea. It will flow in summer and in winter.
The LORD will be King over the whole earth. On that day the LORD will be the only one, and his name the only name.

The whole land, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem, will become like the Arabah. But Jerusalem will be raised up and stay in its place, from the Gate of Benjamin to the place of the First Gate, to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the king's winepresses.
People will live there. There will be no more curse. Jerusalem will be safe.

This is the plague the LORD will send on all the peoples who fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
On that day the LORD will send a great panic among them. Each person will grab the hand of his neighbor, and they will fight each other.
Judah will also fight at Jerusalem. The wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected — great amounts of gold, silver, and clothes.
A similar plague will strike the horses, mules, camels, donkeys, and all the other animals in those camps.
Then everyone left from all the nations that attacked Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
If any of the families of the earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, they will get no rain.
If the people of Egypt do not go up and take part, they will get no rain either. That will be the plague the LORD sends on the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
That will be Egypt's punishment, and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
On that day HOLY TO THE LORD will be written on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the LORD's house will be like the sacred bowls in front of the altar.

Every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies. Everyone who comes to offer a sacrifice will take some of the pots and cook in them. On that day there will no longer be a trader in the house of the LORD of Armies.
